title: The Fossil Lichen Grove

features.name: the oldest count
features.desc-on-touch: A line of numbered stones, each one a debt paid into the earth. You kneel to read them and the numbers blur into dates, then into names that no longer answer.

features.name: the long shadow
features.desc-on-touch: A shadow cast by a debt so ancient it no longer remembers what it owed. The shadow points backward and downward, into the place where the stone learned to hold time.

features.name: the mineralized root
features.desc-on-touch: A tree grown through fossils, its roots reading the debt-layers as it sinks deeper. The lichen that covers it is not green; it is the colour of old copper, old brass, old forgetting.

features.name: the settlement that paid
features.desc-on-touch: A pale structure visible through the haze of lichen dust—a place where the debt was incurred, now rendered as a tiny building drowning in slow growth.

features.name: the archive's breath
features.desc-on-touch: A space where the fossil grove breathes out the settled air of forty-two histories. You feel the weight of what was owed and what could never be repaid, now balanced on a knife-edge between stone and life.

inscription: where what was owed learned to become what is real, and lichen reads the debt in slow colours

file.name: LichenGrowth_AncientStone_Study_1952.txt
file.note: A botanist's careful record of lichen species on stone markers in the high country—corrupted, now: the stone types have changed, the lichen colours have shifted, and the dates run backwards

upward where lichen becomes visible from the sky
where the oldest stones refuse to be named
into the clearing where debts became monuments

reverie.title: REVERIE — the fossil lichen grove at dusk
narr: You kneel beside her on the stone lip where the lichen
has written older than words. She touches a mark with two
fingers—a debt paid so long ago the payer is now the thing
that was purchased. Her finger moves careful, slow. The light
is going. The shadows pool around the oldest stones. You watch
her learn what the lichen has been learning all this time.
